info.title: Potato Viral Disease Dataset
info.subtitle: Potato Viral Disease Image Dataset from ICAR-CPRI Shimla and UAS Dharwad, India
info.description:
This dataset focuses on classifying viral diseases affecting potato plants (Solanum tuberosum), a crucial food crop worldwide. Traditional disease identification methods, such as visual inspection and laboratory techniques (ELISA, RT-PCR), are time-consuming, expensive, and require specialized expertise. This dataset aims to support the development of automated machine-learning models for early and accurate disease detection, enabling farmers to take timely mitigation measures and minimize yield losses.

Data Collection:

The dataset was collected from potato fields at the University of Agricultural Sciences, Dharwad, India. Two cultivation areas were included: one with certified and uncertified seeds. Image data was obtained from the Indian Council of Agricultural Research- Central Potato Research Institute (ICAR- CPRI), Shimla. Images were captured in daylight against a black background, focusing on leaf and tuber symptoms of three primary viral diseases:
1. Mosaic Virus: Characterized by yellowing and mottling of leaves, classified into mild, medium, and severe based on symptom severity. Color features are crucial for classification.
2. Leafroll Virus: Manifested by upward rolling of leaves with a crunchy texture. Shape and texture are key features for accurate classification.
3. Spindle Tuber Virus: Identified by elongated, spindle-shaped tubers. Shape features are essential for classification.

Source: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/rgfhzd5mzw/1
